exposure: suture material used for uterine closure
number of uterine closure layers at primary cesarean
gestational age at primary cesarean delivery
lower uterine segment status (normal vs. abnormal)
cohort: 96 women with a previous cesarean delivery who were admitted for a repeat cesarean at or after 36 weeks gestation
finding: Several factors at primary cesarean delivery, including preterm delivery, single-layer uterine closure, and a longer inter-cesarean interval, were significantly associated with an increased risk of an abnormal lower uterine segment at term in a subsequent pregnancy.
